title: Native Mac client: four server control demonstrations

scenes.title: A permitted S3 read
scenes.description: Send one fixed read_allowed request and allow it once. The client displays the AWS response with a request ID, byte count and digest.
scenes.evidenceScope: Actual macOS Kiro Crew Nightly client turn through the EC2 Gateway and original Kiro CLI backend. Visible UI result; server receipt correlation is reviewed separately. This media review does not assert enforcement acceptance.

source.description: Continuous native Mac window capture. Each clip preserves one request-to-result sequence at the recorded speed.

cues.label: Submit the allowed read
cues.detail: The Mac client sends read_allowed with its unique trace ID.

cues.label: Inspect the permission request
cues.detail: The UI asks to run the exact MCP tool once.

cues.label: Read the result
cues.detail: The client displays ok:true, layer:aws and the S3 result identifiers.

scenes.title: Crew blocks a tool call
scenes.description: Send one crew_denied request. The client displays a tool blocked row and reports the Crew policy refusal without an approval dialog.
scenes.evidenceScope: Actual macOS Kiro Crew Nightly client turn through the EC2 Gateway and original Kiro CLI backend. Visible UI result; server receipt correlation is reviewed separately. This media review does not assert enforcement acceptance.

source.description: Continuous native Mac window capture. Each clip preserves one request-to-result sequence at the recorded speed.

cues.label: Submit the denied tool
cues.detail: The Mac client requests crew_denied with its unique trace ID.

cues.label: See the policy block
cues.detail: The native client shows Tool call blocked for crew_denied.

cues.label: Read the refusal
cues.detail: The final response reports the Crew policy denial and stops.

scenes.title: The MCP service refuses the grant
scenes.description: Send one mcp_denied request and allow it once. The client displays tool_grant_denied from the MCP service.
scenes.evidenceScope: Actual macOS Kiro Crew Nightly client turn through the EC2 Gateway and original Kiro CLI backend. Visible UI result; server receipt correlation is reviewed separately. This media review does not assert enforcement acceptance.

source.description: Continuous native Mac window capture. Each clip preserves one request-to-result sequence at the recorded speed.

cues.label: Submit the MCP request
cues.detail: The Mac client requests mcp_denied with its unique trace ID.

cues.label: Inspect the permission request
cues.detail: The client presents Allow once for the exact tool call.

cues.label: Read the MCP refusal
cues.detail: The client displays ok:false, layer:mcp and tool_grant_denied.

scenes.title: AWS refuses the S3 read
scenes.description: Send one iam_denied request and allow it once. The client displays AccessDenied, HTTP403 and an AWS request ID.
